title: Phase 3.2: Implement Enochian FEN
description:
Implement GameState::to_enoch_fen() and GameState::from_enoch_fen().
Define a string format (or JSON) to represent:
- Board occupancy (4 armies)
- Turn order & current turn
- Frozen status
- King positions & Throne control
- Promotion zones (if variable) or Array ID
This is required for save/load and test fixtures.
